name: Custom Clothing Manufacturer - Fashion Atlas Group
old_description: Fashion Atlas Group helps brands, boutiques, startups, and corporate clients develop, source, manufacture, and deliver apparel collections — from first idea and samples to bulk production, quality control, and logistics.
about:
Fashion Atlas Group began in Kyiv, Ukraine in 2010 as a venture among four friends, including Kyrylo Kostiuchenko, who remains the owner. By 2014 the company expanded internationally, opening a U.S. office and warehouse in Bayonne, New Jersey in 2015. The business is privately owned and founder-led.

The company provides end-to-end apparel services: custom manufacturing, wholesale sourcing, private label production, product development, sampling, fabric sourcing, quality control, packaging, and logistics. It manages production across facilities in China, Turkey, and Ukraine, with warehouses in the U.S., England, Poland, Turkey, and Ukraine. The company reports 450+ partners worldwide, 350+ active suppliers, over 40 private label brands, and around 100,000 SKUs in stock. It handles orders from as low as 5 pieces for wholesale to 2,000+ pieces in two weeks for custom runs.

Fashion Atlas serves fashion brands, boutiques, online retailers, startups, and corporate clients needing uniforms or merchandise. Named clients include Shopakira, Altar’d State, Nordstrom, and Ruelala. Industries span sportswear, restaurant uniforms, protective clothing, military uniforms, corporate apparel, and general fashion.

The company emphasizes a managed workflow that connects sourcing, development, production, inspection, and delivery under one U.S.-based partner, offering safe payments, pre-shipment inspections, and flexible MOQs. It highlights global production control, ethical certifications (ISO 9001, Higg Index, BCI, GRS, SMETA), and a focus on reducing risk for brands entering apparel manufacturing.
built_on: Pre-shipment quality inspections by third parties
Production scaling from low MOQs to large volumes
Door-to-door global delivery from warehouses on three continents
Flexible MOQs: 5 pieces for wholesale, 50 pieces for custom development
volume: Wholesale from 5 pieces per style; custom manufacturing from 50 pieces per style; production capacity of 2,000+ pieces within two weeks; 250M+ units manufactured historically
lead_time: In-stock items: 5 days delivery (or 48 hours for some); custom manufacturing: approximately 2 weeks for 2,000+ pieces
